fieldValues.title: resolve_root_container docstring: embed/file-backed root coexistence is R12-fatal, not richest-source
fieldValues.summary: resolve_root_container's docstring described a containers/*.json file sharing the root embed's id as the richest source to prefer. That state cannot be produced by any current write path (save_container_at folds a same-id write back into the embed) and, if produced anyway (hand-edited or pre-RFC-038 legacy repo), is fatal at catalog build under SRS038-R12-DUPLICATE-ID -- the Ok(container) match arm is unreachable for the embed's own id under any state that is not already fatal. Corrected the docstring and added a negative test proving the coexistence state surfaces as a propagated CatalogLoad error.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from srs#580's gate:dispatched queue (coordinator tick 2026-09-12T~00:20Z, classification row: clear / Repository / Door 1 / auto-merge). Claimed on srs-rust#988 (gate:dispatched -> gate:working). PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/1056 -- doc-only correction plus one new negative test in container_service.rs; no behaviour change, no schema change. Proof stage: temporarily removed "container" from catalog::detect_duplicates's checked sets to confirm the new test goes red (it returned Ok(Some(container)) from the file-backed copy -- exactly the old docstring's wrongly-described "richest source" behaviour) before reverting and confirming green on unmodified logic. Gates green: cargo build --workspace, cargo test --workspace (0 failures, SRS_SPEC_DIR pointed at a fresh origin/master clone of srs per the stale-sibling guidance), cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings. Auto-merge armed (gate:auto-merge on the PR), not hand-merged.
